clue.text: Godfather recalled lines wearing glasses

indicators.note: recalled is read as called back, so the word for father runs in the opposite direction

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father

indicators.note: the glasses have the lines on them, as a face wears spectacles, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: OO looks like a pair of spectacles
L is the abbreviation for line, so LL is lines

explanation.surface: A mafia godfather recalls the lines he delivered while wearing his sunglasses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Godfather' looks like one word but splits into the definition 'God' and the wordplay 'father'; 'recalled' and 'wearing' are the indicators.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek and Roman deity of the sun, music and poetry; also a London theatre, as the puzzle's theme.

clue.text: Agreed, so healthy

parts.note: so, as an intensifier in 'so good', means very
a healthy person is well

explanation.surface: Someone agrees, glad that a patient is now in good shape.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation of assent, like 'all right then' or 'fine', used when consenting to something.

clue.text: Good many become Guides

parts.note: PI, short for pious, is the crossword abbreviation for good
lots means many

explanation.surface: Many good girls go on to join the Girl Guides.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Guides' is capitalised to suggest the youth movement, but here it is a plain verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym as a verb: someone who steers a ship or plane, or leads people, is said to do this.

clue.text: Trouble being on time delivering letter

indicators.note: in a down entry one piece being on another sits above it, so the first comes before the second

parts.note: a mess is a troublesome situation
an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: A postman's trouble comes from being on time when delivering a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A letter is one kind of written communication sent to someone, which is what this word names.

clue.text: Yellow fish gobbled up, uncooked

indicators.note: the fish gobbles the other piece, taking it inside

parts.note: a cod is a fish

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the word is written from bottom to top

parts.note: uncooked means raw

explanation.surface: A yellow fish gobbles something up raw.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gobbled' signals the insertion and 'up' the reversal. 'Yellow' is slang for lacking courage; Noel Coward the playwright fits the theatrical theme.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang: being yellow means lacking courage, and a person lacking courage is called this noun used attributively.

clue.text: Playwright's shocking and her plot's about independence, right?

indicators.note: the rearranged letters are placed about, that is around, the single letter for independence
shocking suggests the letters are thrown into disorder and rearranged

explanation.surface: A shocked question about a play whose heroine plots for her independence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shocking' rearranges AND HER PLOT; 'about' puts that around I, and R ends it.
explanation.definitionFit: Nobel-winning English dramatist, author of The Birthday Party and The Caretaker.

clue.text: Desires a soft, small French salad for starter

parts.note: P, for piano, is the musical abbreviation for soft
petite is French for small (feminine form)

indicators.note: the starter of the word salad is its opening letter

explanation.surface: Someone longs for a soft, small French salad as a first course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for starter' looks like a menu instruction but takes only the first letter of 'salad'.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural synonym: cravings or hungers, especially for food, are another way to say desires.

clue.text: Magnificent, faithful leader swapping sides …

indicators.note: the leading letter stands for left and is swapped for the letter for the other side, right

parts.note: loyal means faithful

explanation.surface: A magnificent, faithful party leader defects to the other side.
explanation.walkthrough: The leader of LOYAL is L, for left; swapping sides changes it to R, for right.
explanation.definitionFit: Fit for a monarch, so splendid or magnificent, as in a regal welcome.

clue.text: … as you help construct a theatre

indicators.note: to construct is to build something new from the parts, so the letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: A plea, continuing the previous clue, for help building a theatre.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links this to 8 across, but the clue stands on its own.
explanation.definitionFit: A theatre building, especially one for stage plays; several London theatres carry this name.

clue.text: Hotel, for example, housing 50?

indicators.note: the first piece houses, or contains, the second

parts.note: say means for example, as in 'a fruit, say an apple'
50 is read digit by digit: V is Roman five and O looks like zero

explanation.surface: A question whether a particular hotel, say, has fifty rooms.
explanation.walkthrough: '50' is not L here: write 5 as Roman V and 0 as the letter O.
explanation.definitionFit: The Savoy is a famous luxury hotel on the Strand in London, next to the theatre of the same name.

clue.text: Room for hire? Initially, everyone

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of the word that precedes it

parts.note: all means everyone

explanation.surface: An advertisement for a room to hire that is open to everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: A large room for meetings or events, often one that can be hired, is called this.

clue.text: Loads sleep with partners

parts.note: to doze is to sleep lightly
N and S, north and south, are partners at bridge

explanation.surface: Someone sleeps a lot alongside their partners.
explanation.walkthrough: In bridge, North and South play as partners, giving NS.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal plural for large numbers: having loads of something means having many twelves of it.

clue.text: Government managed 500 promotions for relatives

parts.note: ran means managed, as in ran a business
D is the Roman numeral for 500
ads, advertisements, are promotions

explanation.surface: A government scheme handed out 500 promotions to members of one family.
explanation.definitionFit: Grandfathers are family members, so they are relatives.

clue.text: English bowler hat folds twice, centrally

indicators.note: centrally takes the central letter of each of the three words before it

explanation.surface: A bowler hat that has been folded twice in the middle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bowler hat' reads as headwear, but 'bowler' is a cricketer.
explanation.definitionFit: Moeen Ali and Kabir Ali are English cricketers who have bowled for England.

clue.text: Gentleman sent back fried meat dish — fish is off

indicators.note: sent back means the remaining letters are written in reverse order
the fish is off the menu, so it is taken away from the dish

parts.note: a rissole is a fried cake of minced meat
a sole is a flatfish

explanation.surface: A gentleman diner sends his fried meat back because the fish is off.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing SOLE from RISSOLE leaves RIS, which 'sent back' reverses.
explanation.definitionFit: A courteous form of address for a man, or the title of a knight, so a gentleman.

clue.text: Intense colour contains navy

indicators.note: the colour word contains the single letter inside it

parts.note: violet is a colour

explanation.surface: An intense colour is mixed with navy blue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'navy' looks like a second colour but it is just the letter N.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something extreme in force, such as a storm or passion, is described as intense.

clue.text: Small boy, about 4, does a cartwheel

indicators.note: a cartwheel turns the body over, so the pieces are flipped end to end

parts.note: C, for circa, means about
IV is the Roman numeral for 4

explanation.surface: A small boy of about four turns a cartwheel.
explanation.definitionFit: Short form of the boy's name Victor; a small name, not a small child, and the Old Vic is a London theatre.

clue.text: Antique is regularly oiled

indicators.note: regularly takes every other letter, starting with the first

explanation.surface: An antique piece of furniture is regularly oiled.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an antique is something from long ago, so it is aged.

clue.text: Christmas sign up after 1st of November

indicators.note: after places the reversed sign after the letter from November
1st of takes the opening letter of November
in a down entry, up means the word is written from bottom to top

parts.note: Leo is a sign of the zodiac

explanation.surface: A Christmas sign goes up early, just after the start of November.
explanation.definitionFit: A French-derived word for Christmas, heard in carols such as 'The First Noel'.

clue.text: Over 50? I struggle to get right actor

parts.note: O is the cricket abbreviation for over
L is the Roman numeral for 50
to vie is to struggle or compete

explanation.surface: A man over fifty struggles to get the acting part right.
explanation.definitionFit: Laurence Olivier was a celebrated English stage and film actor, and the Olivier is a National Theatre stage.

clue.text: Bad driver holds up 10 for judge's preliminary examination of a witness

definitions.text: judge's preliminary examination of a witness

indicators.note: the rearranged letters hold the other piece inside them
bad suggests the letters are damaged and so rearranged
in a down entry, up means the piece is written from bottom to top

parts.note: 10 is read digit by digit: I for one and O for zero

explanation.surface: A bad driver holds up traffic at ten and is examined by a judge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bad' is the anagram signal, 'holds' the insertion and 'up' the reversal. '10' could mean 10 across, SAVOY, but here it is the two digits, one and zero.
explanation.definitionFit: A legal term for the questioning of a witness or juror by the court to establish competence before the trial proper.

clue.text: On turning, whisk ain't making jelly

indicators.note: turning means the piece is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: leg is the on side in cricket, so on means leg

indicators.note: to whisk is to beat and mix, so the letters are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: Turning on the mixer, someone whisks ingredients but cannot make the jelly set.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the leg side is also the on side; 'turning' gives GEL, and 'whisk' rearranges AINT.
explanation.definitionFit: The protein from animal collagen that sets puddings and jellies; also the setting agent itself.

clue.text: Physician returns US weapon in pouch

indicators.note: returns means the word goes back the other way

parts.note: doc is short for doctor, a physician
piece is American slang for a gun

explanation.surface: A doctor comes back carrying an American gun in a pouch.
explanation.definitionFit: A pouch worn over the front of men's breeches in the 15th and 16th centuries.

clue.text: Campaigns not getting into corrupted works

indicators.note: the campaigns are not getting a group of letters, so those letters are taken out

parts.note: military operations are campaigns
the four letters of into, corrupted (spoiled and rearranged), give TION

explanation.surface: Campaigns fail to infiltrate some corrupt works.
explanation.walkthrough: 'into' looks like a link word, but 'corrupted' rearranges it to TION, which is removed from OPERATIONS.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural of the Latin opus, a work, so musical dramas and compositions count as works.

clue.text: See 6
Musician, one who used to tour with Queen?

definitions.meaning: the American singer and guitarist behind Purple Rain

definitions.text: one who used to tour with Queen?
definitions.meaning: ... Philip, the late Duke of Edinburgh, toured with Queen Elizabeth II for decades

explanation.surface: A musician who used to tour as support for the band Queen.
explanation.walkthrough: Queen the rock band is the surface reading; the royal Queen is the second sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: the pop star known by this single name, and a royal consort such as Philip.

clue.text: Priest's after the style of church residence

parts.note: a la, from French, means in the style of
CE, Church of England, stands for church

explanation.surface: A priest lives in a church residence built in some particular style.
explanation.definitionFit: A grand official home of a monarch or bishop is a residence; also a London theatre, fitting the theme.

clue.text: Region of land has no river

indicators.note: has no means the following letter is left out

parts.note: a country is a land

explanation.surface: A region of land has no river running through it.
explanation.definitionFit: An administrative region of Britain or Ireland, such as Kent or Cork, is a shire or district of this kind.

clue.text: Write extremely neatly for money

parts.note: to pen is to write

indicators.note: extremely takes the extreme letters, first and last, of the next word

explanation.surface: Someone is paid to write very neatly.
explanation.definitionFit: A small British coin, one hundredth of a pound, is a piece of money.

clue.text: Friend twisted dial — not sure it's heavy metal

parts.note: pal means friend

indicators.note: twisted means the letters are turned into a new order

parts.note: um is a hesitant sound made when not sure

explanation.surface: A friend twisting a radio dial is unsure whether heavy metal is on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heavy metal' reads as rock music but is the dense chemical element; 'twisted' rearranges DIAL to LADI.
explanation.definitionFit: A dense silvery element of the platinum group, so literally a heavy metal; also the London Palladium theatre.

clue.text: Country with drinks

parts.note: ales are drinks

explanation.surface: A country known for its drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the four countries making up the United Kingdom, west of England.

clue.text: Las Vegas entertains Queen with candour

indicators.note: the city entertains, or holds as a guest, the other piece inside it

parts.note: Sin City is a nickname for Las Vegas
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the abbreviation for Queen

explanation.surface: Las Vegas entertains the Queen, who speaks frankly.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: honesty and frankness of manner, saying what one truly means, is candour.
